# Contract: Audit Log Viewer

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- the web application is running and reachable, with the request context, the authorization guard and the audit writer of F01
- PostgreSQL is reachable with every migration applied, including the F15 viewer indexes; `audit_event` has a monthly partition for each month that holds seeded events
- a browser is available for UI and E2E items

**Configuration:**
- the session cookie issued by sign-in is the only credential the viewer and its endpoints accept
- dates in requests and displays are interpreted in the organization's time zone (`America/Sao_Paulo` for the organizations above)

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready.

- **Lint** — `npm run lint` — ESLint passes, including module boundaries and the no-literal-text rule
- **Typecheck** — `npm run typecheck` — Next.js type generation and `tsc --noEmit` report no errors
- **Format** — `npm run format:check` — Prettier reports every file formatted
- **Unit tests** — `npm test` — every Vitest unit test passes, including catalog parity across pt-BR, en and es
- **Integration tests** — `npm run test:integration` — every Testcontainers integration test passes against real PostgreSQL
- **Schema drift** — `npx prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code` — after the migrations are applied, the database matches `prisma/schema.prisma` with no difference

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Access

#### `API-ACCESS-01` — administrator reads the audit log
- given: `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-sample` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/events with no query parameters
- then:
  - 200 OK with body { period, items, nextCursor, matched, pageSize: 100, exportLimit: 100000, timeZone: "America/Sao_Paulo" }
  - `period` spans the last 30 days including today in the organization's time zone
  - every item has { id, occurredAt, actor { type, userId, name, active }, action, entityType, entityId, summary, hasChanges }

#### `API-ACCESS-02` — other roles are refused and the refusal is audited
- given: for each of `manager-a`, `desk-a` and `pro-a`, that user is signed in
- when: GET /api/audit/events, GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-patient-update} and GET /api/audit/export
- then:
  - each response is 403 with code AUTHZ_FORBIDDEN
  - no response body contains audit events or CSV content
  - each refused request leaves a `PERMISSION_DENIED` event of that user in `org-A` naming the permission "audit:read"
- notes: one assertion set per user and endpoint (nine requests)

#### `API-ACCESS-03` — no session
- given: no session cookie
- when: GET /api/audit/events, GET /api/audit/events/{any uuid} and GET /api/audit/export
- then:
  - each response is 401 with code AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED

### Search events

**Common given:** `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-sample` and `ev-b-update` exist.

#### `API-SEARCH-01` — default period, newest first
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events
- then:
  - items are ordered by `occurredAt` descending
  - `ev-patient-update`, `ev-note-update`, `ev-denied` and `ev-system` are present
  - `ev-old` is absent
  - `ev-patient-update` shows actor name "Ana Admin", action "UPDATE", entity `patient` / `patient-p1-id`, summary "Paciente atualizado", hasChanges true

#### `API-SEARCH-02` — custom period reaches older events
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?from={date 400 days ago}&to={date 100 days ago}
- then:
  - `ev-old` is present
  - no event of the last 30 days is present

#### `API-SEARCH-03` — user filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?user={id of desk-a}
- then:
  - every item has actor userId = id of `desk-a`
  - `ev-patient-create` and `ev-denied` are present
  - `ev-login-failed` is absent (anonymous actor)

#### `API-SEARCH-04` — inactive user filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?user={id of bruno-a}
- then:
  - exactly `ev-bruno` is returned
  - its actor shows name "Bruno Antigo" with active false

#### `API-SEARCH-05` — system actor filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?user=SYSTEM
- then:
  - every item has actor type "SYSTEM"
  - `ev-system` is present

#### `API-SEARCH-06` — action filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?action=PERMISSION_DENIED
- then:
  - every item has action "PERMISSION_DENIED"
  - `ev-denied` is present

#### `API-SEARCH-07` — entity type filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityType=clinical_note
- then:
  - every item has entityType "clinical_note"
  - `ev-note-update` and `ev-note-read` are present

#### `API-SEARCH-08` — entity type and id filter
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityType=patient&entityId=patient-p1-id
- then:
  - exactly `ev-patient-update` and `ev-patient-create` are returned, newest first
  - `ev-b-update` is absent

#### `API-SEARCH-09` — filters intersect
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?user={id of admin-a}&action=UPDATE&entityType=patient&entityId=patient-p1-id
- then:
  - exactly `ev-patient-update` is returned

#### `API-SEARCH-10` — period longer than 366 days is rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?from={date 400 days ago}&to={today}
- then:
  - 400 with code AUDIT_PERIOD_TOO_LONG
  - the message reads "O período deve ter no máximo 366 dias."

#### `API-SEARCH-11` — entity id requires an entity type
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityId=patient-p1-id
- then:
  - 400 with code AUDIT_ENTITY_TYPE_REQUIRED
  - the message reads "Escolha o tipo de entidade para filtrar por id."

#### `API-SEARCH-12` — other organizations are never visible
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityType=patient
- then:
  - `ev-b-update` is absent
  - every returned event belongs to `org-A`

### Pagination

#### `API-PAGE-01` — 100 per page with keyset cursors
- given: `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-page-set` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/events?action=LOGOUT, then GET again with each returned `nextCursor` until it is null
- then:
  - the first and second responses hold 100 items each and the third holds 50
  - the third response has `nextCursor` null
  - the 250 ids across the three pages are distinct and ordered by `occurredAt` descending
  - `matched` is { count: 250, capped: false } on every page

### Performance

#### `API-PERF-01` — p95 within 3 seconds with 1 million events
- given: `admin-load` is signed in; `audit-load` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/events 20 times for each combination: last 366 days only; user = one actor; action = PERMISSION_DENIED; entityType = patient; entityType = patient with entityId = load-patient-id; user + action + entityType together; and the second page (with `nextCursor`) of the period-only search
- then:
  - the 95th percentile of the response time per combination is ≤ 3 seconds
  - every returned item satisfies the filters of its request
  - each first page of a combination with more than 100 matches holds exactly 100 items
- notes: measured from request to complete response body on the test environment

### Event detail

**Common given:** `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-sample` and `ev-b-update` exist.

#### `API-DETAIL-01` — update shows field-level before and after
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-patient-update}
- then:
  - 200 with action "UPDATE", ipAddress "203.0.113.10" and actor name "Ana Admin"
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `fullName` with before "Maria Souza" and after "Maria Souza Lima"
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `phoneMobile` with before "+5511988881111" and after "+5511977772222"
  - `changes` holds no other entry

#### `API-DETAIL-02` — clinical change shows only the counts
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-note-update}
- then:
  - `changes` holds one entry for `content` with kind "sensitive", beforeLength 120, afterLength 154
  - that entry has before null and after null
  - the response body contains no clinical text

#### `API-DETAIL-03` — metadata is listed
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-denied}
- then:
  - `metadata` holds { key: "permission", value: "audit:read" }
  - `metadata` holds { key: "target", value: "/settings/audit" }

#### `API-DETAIL-04` — another organization's event is not found
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-b-update}
- then:
  - 404 with code AUDIT_EVENT_NOT_FOUND
  - the body holds none of the event's fields

#### `API-DETAIL-05` — secret-like fields are never shown
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-secret}
- then:
  - `changes` holds one entry for `approvalPinHash` with kind "hidden"
  - the response body contains neither "old-hash" nor "new-hash"

### F01 events in the viewer

**Common given:** `admin-a` is signed in; `admin-a` has changed the organization's trade name of `org-A` from "Clínica Auditoria" to "Clínica Auditoria Centro" through the F01 organization settings.

#### `API-F01-01` — the F01 update is searchable
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityType=organization&action=UPDATE
- then:
  - the newest item is that update, with actor name "Ana Admin" and hasChanges true

#### `API-F01-02` — the F01 update shows its before and after values
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of that update}
- then:
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `tradeName` with before "Clínica Auditoria" and after "Clínica Auditoria Centro"

### Export

#### `API-EXPORT-01` — CSV in the F13 format (pt-BR)
- given: `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-sample` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/export?entityType=clinical_note
- then:
  - 200 with headers { Content-Type: "text/csv; charset=utf-8", Content-Disposition: attachment; filename `auditoria-YYYY-MM-DD-YYYY-MM-DD.csv`, X-Report-Rows: "2" }
  - the body starts with a UTF-8 BOM
  - lines end with CRLF
  - the header row reads "Data;Hora;Usuário;Ação;Tipo de entidade;Id da entidade;Resumo;Alterações;Endereço IP;Id do evento"
  - the row of `ev-note-update` has the "Alterações" cell "content: conteúdo clínico alterado (120 → 154 caracteres)"
  - the body contains no clinical text

#### `API-EXPORT-02` — CSV follows the user's language (en)
- given: `admin-en` is signed in; `audit-sample` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/export?entityType=patient&entityId=patient-p1-id
- then:
  - the header row is in English
  - cells are separated by commas
  - dates are written in the en format of the user's language
  - the row of `ev-patient-update` lists `fullName: Maria Souza → Maria Souza Lima` in its changes cell

#### `API-EXPORT-03` — 100,000 rows are exported
- given: `admin-load` is signed in; `export-day-1` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/export?from={date one day ago}&to={date one day ago}&action=LOGIN
- then:
  - 200 with X-Report-Rows "100000"
  - the body holds exactly 100,000 data rows after the header
  - the 100,000 event ids in the body are distinct

#### `API-EXPORT-04` — above 100,000 rows the export is refused
- given: `admin-load` is signed in; `export-day-2` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/export?from={date two days ago}&to={date two days ago}&action=LOGIN
- then:
  - 422 with code AUDIT_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE and a JSON body
  - the message says the CSV export accepts up to 100.000 rows
  - no `EXPORT` event with entity type `audit_log` is recorded for this request

#### `API-EXPORT-05` — the export is itself audited
- given: `admin-a` is signed in; `audit-sample` exists
- when: GET /api/audit/export?action=UPDATE
- then:
  - a new `EXPORT` event exists in `org-A` with actor `admin-a` and entity type `audit_log`
  - its metadata holds format "csv", the exported row count, and the filters { from, to, user: "ALL", action: "UPDATE", entityType: "ALL" }
  - a following GET /api/audit/events?action=EXPORT returns that event

### Anonymized patients

**Common given:** `admin-a` is signed in; `patient-anon` and `audit-anon` exist.

#### `API-ANON-01` — personal fields of earlier events are masked
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-anon-update}
- then:
  - 200 with action "UPDATE", ipAddress "203.0.113.10" and actor name "Ana Admin"
  - `changes` holds an entry for `fullName` with kind "anonymized" and before null and after null
  - `changes` holds an entry for `mobilePhone` with kind "anonymized" and before null and after null
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `sex` with before "NOT_INFORMED" and after "FEMALE"
  - the response body contains neither "Joana" nor "5511955550000" nor "5511944440000"

#### `API-ANON-02` — the anonymization event stays readable
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-anon-final}
- then:
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `anonymized` with before "Não" and after "Sim"
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `active` with before "Sim" and after "Não"
  - `metadata` holds { key: "anonymizedCode", value: "A1B2C3" }

#### `API-ANON-03` — an event that only references the patient is not masked
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events/{id of ev-anon-lgpd}
- then:
  - `changes` holds a `value` entry for `status` with before "PROCESSING" and after "COMPLETED"
  - `changes` holds no entry with kind "anonymized"

#### `API-ANON-04` — the events stay searchable with their summaries
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/events?entityType=patient&entityId=patient-anon-id
- then:
  - exactly `ev-anon-final`, `ev-anon-update` and `ev-anon-create` are returned, newest first
  - `ev-anon-update` shows summary "Cadastro do paciente alterado" and hasChanges true
  - `ev-anon-update` shows actor name "Ana Admin"

#### `API-ANON-05` — the CSV masks personal fields and the stored events are unchanged
- given: (default)
- when: GET /api/audit/export?entityType=patient&entityId=patient-anon-id
- then:
  - 200 with X-Report-Rows "3"
  - the row of `ev-anon-update` has the "Alterações" cell "fullName: dado anonimizado | mobilePhone: dado anonimizado | sex: NOT_INFORMED → FEMALE"
  - the body contains neither "Joana" nor "5511955550000" nor "5511944440000"
  - the stored row of `ev-anon-update` still holds the original before and after values of `fullName` and `mobilePhone`

## UI

**Verification mode:** Render the surface, drive it with user-like inputs (clicks, typing, keyboard); assert observable surface state (DOM, accessibility tree, visible text, navigation).

### Access

#### `UI-ACCESS-01` — administrator finds Auditoria in the settings
- given: `admin-a` is signed in
- when: open the sidebar group "Configurações" and click "Auditoria"
- then:
  - the page navigates to /settings/audit
  - the level-1 heading reads "Auditoria"
  - the "Auditoria" sidebar item is marked as the active item

#### `UI-ACCESS-02` — other roles see neither the item nor the page
- given: `desk-a` is signed in
- when: navigate to /settings/audit
- then:
  - the 403 page is shown
  - the sidebar has no "Auditoria" item

### Search events

**Common given:** `admin-a` is signed in on /settings/audit; `audit-sample` exists.

#### `UI-SEARCH-01` — filter bar and result table
- given: (default)
- when: the page finishes loading
- then:
  - the filter bar shows the fields De, Até, Usuário, Ação, Tipo de entidade and Id da entidade, each with a visible label
  - De and Até hold the last 30 days including today
  - the table has the column headers Data e hora, Usuário, Ação, Entidade, Resumo
  - the row of `ev-patient-update` shows "Ana Admin", the stamp "ATUALIZAÇÃO", "Paciente" and "Paciente atualizado"
  - "Exportar CSV" is the only primary button on the screen

#### `UI-SEARCH-02` — changing a filter updates the table and the URL
- given: (default)
- when: choose "Permissão negada" in Ação
- then:
  - every table row shows the stamp "PERMISSÃO NEGADA"
  - the row of `ev-denied` is present
  - the URL contains `action=PERMISSION_DENIED`

#### `UI-SEARCH-03` — entity id needs an entity type
- given: (default)
- when: choose "Paciente" in Tipo de entidade
- then:
  - Id da entidade, disabled before, becomes enabled
  - the URL contains `entityType=patient`

#### `UI-SEARCH-04` — empty result
- given: (default)
- when: choose "Exclusão" in Ação
- then:
  - the table is replaced by a text that says no event matches the filters
  - the filters stay as chosen
  - "Exportar CSV" is disabled with its reason written next to it

## E2E

**Verification mode:** Run the full system (web application, worker and database); drive it through a real browser the way a real user would; assert cross-stack behavior.

- when: on /patients/patient-p1-id change the mobile phone to "+5511966663333" and save; open Configurações > Auditoria; choose "Atualização" in Ação and "Paciente" in Tipo de entidade; open the newest row; click "Exportar CSV"
